The crown has since been passed to Labour politician Bev Craig, who won almost two-thirds of the overall vote share But it’s clear from the statistics published by the Greater Manchester Combined Authority that not everybody understood what they were doing with their ballots. This year’s vote was carried out using the ‘supplementary voting system’ – meaning everyone could choose a first and a Yet more than 4,400 people’s votes for the Greater Manchester Mayoral election weren’t counted because people placed their first and second vote crosses in the same column. Almost 13,000 other voters only used one of their two votes. Many people find themselves avoiding photographs, covering their mouth when they laugh, or struggling to enjoy their favourite foods. It's easy to believe these changes are simply something you have to live with Unfortunately, the effects of tooth loss don't stop there. Over time, the jawbone can begin to shrink and neighbouring teeth may come under additional strain, potentially leading to further problems. Fortunately, modern dentistry offers a solution that looks, feels and functions A dental implant is a small titanium replacement for the root of a missing tooth. Once healed, a bespoke crown is attached, creating a replacement tooth virtually indistinguishable from the real thing Unlike dentures, implants are fixed securely in place - no slipping, movement or adhesives required. Alberta opened its regulated competitive iGaming market on July 13, 2026, joining Ontario, whose market has been open since April 4, 2022. A United supporter in Canada can now watch a league reducing one of football’s most vi That creates an unusual setup for anyone following United and soccer betting from Canada. The measure was voluntary and narrow. It applies to the front of the playing shirt, not to every place a betting company can appear a Sleeves can still carry commercial branding. Training wear remains available. Stadium boards and digital content weren’t swept away by the front-of-shirt agreement.
